reader.zh-Hant:
SkillRegistry 在啟動時掃描技能資料夾，載入 meta.json 與 instructions.md，並提供精確查詢與摘要列表。

type.Skill 描述的是記憶體中的技能物件欄位；class.SkillRegistry 則負責載入與 reload 語意（例如 load_skills() 會清空後重建）。

缺檔的資料夾會被跳過並留下 log；這是刻意的容錯策略，方便在 skills/ 目錄逐步擴充。

撰寫新的技能 SOP 請參考 [撰寫技能 SOP (Skill)](/docs/how-to/zh-Hant/07-skill-authoring.md)。
reader.en:
`SkillRegistry` scans a skills directory at startup, loading `meta.json` + `instructions.md`, and exposes exact lookup plus human-readable summaries.

`type.Skill` documents the in-memory record shape; `SkillRegistry.load_skills()` clears and rebuilds the registry for deterministic reloads.

Incomplete folders are skipped with warnings—an intentional resilience pattern while you grow `skills/`.

To write new skill SOPs, see [Skill Authoring](/docs/how-to/en/07-skill-authoring.md).
reader.ja:
`SkillRegistry` はスキルディレクトリを走査し、`meta.json` と `instructions.md` を読み込み、完全一致取得と要約一覧を提供します。

`type.Skill` はメモリ上のレコード形、`load_skills()` はクリア後に再構築するなどリロード語義が明確です。

不足ファイルがあるフォルダは警告付きでスキップされ、`skills/` を段階的に増やすための耐性設計です。

新しいスキル SOP の執筆については [スキル SOP の執筆 (Skill)](/docs/how-to/ja/07-skill-authoring.md) を参照してください。

types.name: Skill
types.summary: In-memory representation of one skill package loaded from the skills directory.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Skill identifier shown to the model.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short skill summary used for lookup and skill listings.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Full markdown SOP loaded from instructions.md.

fields.name: required_tools
fields.description: Optional declared tool dependencies from meta.json.

symbols.name: SkillRegistry
symbols.summary: Load skill packages from disk and expose lookup-friendly summaries for the agent.

params.name: skill_directory
params.description: Directory that contains per-skill folders with meta.json and instructions.md.

behavior.side_effects: Creates the skill directory if missing, initializes an empty skills dict, then calls load_skills().

methods.name: load_skills
methods.summary: Reload all skills from disk into memory.
behavior: Clears self.skills before scanning so repeated reloads do not accumulate stale entries.
Scans skill folders in sorted name order for deterministic output.
Skips folders missing meta.json or instructions.md and logs a warning.

methods.name: get_skill
methods.summary: Return a skill object by exact registered name.

methods.name: get_skill_summaries
methods.summary: Return a newline-delimited bullet list of available skills and their descriptions.

runtime_notes.content: Each skill folder is expected to contain both meta.json and instructions.md. Missing either file causes the folder to be skipped.
SkillRegistry only loads text SOPs. Actual execution still happens through the model and registered tools, typically via LookupSkillTool.
load_skills() rebuilds the entire registry from disk, which is useful after editing skill instructions during development.
